# Vendored graph renderer

- Cytoscape.js **3.33.1**, core only; no runtime dependencies or extensions.
- Upstream: https://js.cytoscape.org/
- npm package metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/cytoscape/3.33.1
- `cytoscape-3.33.1.min.js` is the unmodified `package/dist/cytoscape.min.js` from that version's npm tarball. Its SHA-512 tarball integrity was checked against npm's `dist.integrity` during download.
- The upstream MIT license is retained in `CYTOSCAPE-LICENSE.txt`.

Served locally by FastAPI to make the demo independent of a CDN. Approximately 434 KB uncompressed JavaScript. This third-party license applies to Cytoscape.js, not automatically to the rest of the project.
